info.title: NeNe Serve — Admin API
info.description: Operator console surface (ADR 0018). Every route except login requires a short-lived JWT bearer token; each operation additionally gates on an RBAC Capability and is tenant-scoped. Mutations are audited and atomic (ADR 0022); governed data is append-only (archive/disable/erase are additive tombstones, never physical deletes). Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details; JSON is snake_case.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a short-lived JWT.

get.summary: List users in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create an invited user and email a single-use set-password link (manage_users). The raw token is never returned.
Accept an invitation and set the password (unauthenticated; single-use token).

get.summary: Validate an invitation token (unauthenticated); returns the invitee email.
Placement metrics time-series (CTR, fill rate). Sensitive breakdowns require view_sensitive_metrics and are audited.

post.summary: Record a data-subject request (export or erasure). Erasure is an additive tombstone; counts are preserved.
Place a legal hold (blocks retention purge).
Release a legal hold (audited).

get.summary: Get the tenant's SMTP settings (never returns the password).

put.summary: Update SMTP settings (password encrypted at rest; omit to keep existing). Audited.

password.description: Plaintext; encrypted at rest. Omit/empty to keep the stored one.

post.summary: Send a test email through the saved SMTP config to the acting operator. Audited.

get.summary: List placements in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create a placement (audited).
Archive a placement (additive tombstone, audited — never a physical delete).

get.summary: List creatives in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create a creative draft (image/video/html5_bundle).
Upload an image/video asset (base64 JSON; allowlisted content types). Returns the public asset URL.
Submit a draft for review (html5 must be malware-scan-clean).
Move a submitted creative into review.
Approve a creative (four-eyes: an approver may not approve their own submission).
Reject a creative under review.
Request changes on a creative under review.
Create a new immutable version from an existing creative.

get.summary: Creatives awaiting review in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create an advertiser.

get.summary: List pricing rules in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create an immutable, versioned pricing rule (JPY net, no tax/float).

get.summary: List campaigns in the caller's tenant.

post.summary: Create a campaign with a budget (net minor units).

get.summary: Get a campaign with derived billable spend.

post.summary: Open a billing period for a campaign.
Idempotent, net-only, failure-isolated handoff of a campaign to a sibling Deal opportunity.

get.summary: Get a billing period with its tamper-evident spend snapshot.

post.summary: Close a billing period (immutable; re-close is 409).
Hand off a closed period's net total to NeNe Invoice (idempotent on external_reference).

IncludeSensitive.name: include_sensitive
IncludeSensitive.description: Requires the view_sensitive_metrics capability; access is audited (metrics.read_sensitive).

has_password.description: Whether a password is stored (the password itself is never returned).
